name: yellow-comet
_comment: Pitch-black ring (no background layer) with one fast yellow comet
racing the 1920px closed loop at constant speed (physics.wrap, no
drive modulation, no forces) with a modest fading trail via layer
'trail' decay+blur. tone_map is 'clip' (not 'reinhard') so the head's
#ffdd00 linear-1.0 red channel round-trips to a true 255 instead of
being rolled off to ~186 by reinhard's x/(1+x) curve.
